title: Similar: Reserve Feasibility and Congestion Audit
goal: Given a MATPOWER network snapshot and a proposed dispatch-and-reserve schedule, generate `dispatch_audit.json` summarizing generator capacity-coupling compliance, reserve sufficiency, total load versus scheduled generation, and the three most heavily loaded branches under the proposed plan.
skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on parsing MATPOWER bus, generator, branch, and reserve fields, building the correct bus-number mapping, and turning the network topology into operational checks without relying on any other shipped skill.
